architecture_pattern: external sensing endpoints plus wearable compute box

storage_policy.principle: The system disk boots and controls the device; the NVMe SSD carries model and runtime workloads.
storage_policy.decision: Use the SD card for OS, code, Python venv, systemd units, and recovery. Use the 2TB NVMe SSD for GGUF models, mmproj, uploads, event logs, RAG indexes, benchmarks, and field data.

power_supply.adapter: USB-C PD 20V trigger to 5.5x2.5mm DC barrel plug
power_supply.role: wearable power source for Jetson compute box
validation_required_before_model_load: Confirm the barrel plug outputs about 20V with a multimeter.
Confirm the adapter is a PD trigger, not a passive USB-C to DC cable.
Run an idle tegrastats baseline before model stress.
Watch for reboot, undervoltage, NVMe reset, thermal throttle, and service restart events.
power_supply.safety_note: This power bank is not an intrinsically safe hazardous-area power source; place the compute box and battery outside hazardous zones unless a compliant enclosure and site approval are available.

evidence_notes: At 2026-05-18 10:41:41 CST the Jetson reported up 16 min, which places the boot around 10:25 CST.
The 16:02 CST remaining battery reading was reported by the operator from the PB551 display.
A router power interruption broke Windows-to-Jetson LAN reachability; this is a network infrastructure interruption, not evidence of Jetson shutdown.
Power is estimated from PB551 percentage and rated energy; the percentage curve may be nonlinear.

engineering_notes: Keep large model binaries out of Git and store them on the NVMe SSD.
Keep the SD card recoverable: OS, code, venv, and service units only.
Use a thermal pad or heatsink on the SSD for sustained model serving and write-heavy debugging.
Verify the SSD with lsblk, findmnt /mnt/nvme, df -h /mnt/nvme, and a short write/read smoke test before demos.
Before running model stress from the wearable power bank, establish a power baseline with nvpmodel -q, tegrastats, service status, healthz, and kernel logs.
